title: Crispy Fried Delight Bites
description: A crispy fried keto delight in bite-sized form, perfect as a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: Delight
ingredients.notes: preferably a sweet or savory delight

ingredients.name: Starch
ingredients.notes: a low-carb starch like almond flour or coconut flour

ingredients.name: Air
ingredients.notes: for frying, do not attempt to use air as a primary ingredient

instructions: Cut the delight into small bite-sized pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the starch and a pinch of salt.
Dip each delight piece into the starch mixture, coating evenly.
Place the coated delight pieces in the air fryer basket.
Fry the delight bites for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the delight bites from the air fryer and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve the crispy fried delight bites immediately.
